While wearable ECG devices show high accuracy for atrial fibrillation detection, abnormal readings must be critically evaluated by an experienced physician to distinguish true arrhythmia from noise or artifacts [ehra2022_digital_devices_arrhythmias].

Escalate for specialist cardiac evaluation within 24 hours of detection, as delayed assessment is associated with worse outcomes [PMC99048217]. Confirm findings with an ECG recording if possible [ehra2022_digital_devices_arrhythmias].
